about.title: Hi, I'm Anna
body: Creative by nature, in love with all things beautiful and the person at the helm of <ig>@theperfectmatch.wed</ig>.

My relationship with weddings began a few years ago, before I started planning them. Since then I've been lucky enough to experience them from many angles, seeing up close the emotion, the nerves and the magic around every "I do". All of it taught me that a wedding is much more than an event: it's a unique, unrepeatable moment full of meaning.
That's how The Perfect Match was born: a place where dreams take shape and become elegant, deeply personal moments you'll never forget.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Planning, design and coordination for couples who want a thoughtful process and an impeccably executed wedding day.

planning.title: Full planning
planning.description: Timeline, budget, guidance and vendor coordination from the first conversation to the final detail.

artDirection.title: Art direction
artDirection.description: Visual concept, palette, florals, furniture and styling to create a wedding with a clear point of view.

production.title: Production and logistics
production.description: Run sheets, setup, technical supervision and team management so everything happens seamlessly.

coordination.title: Wedding day coordination
coordination.description: We take care of the timing, suppliers and every small issue so you can stay fully present.

destination.title: Destination weddings
destination.description: Full support for celebrations away from home, with a polished experience for both you and your guests.

honeymoon.title: Honeymoon
honeymoon.description: Tailored travel design as a natural extension of the celebration, with pacing and bookings curated for you.

portfolio.title: Real stories, soulful productions
portfolio.subtitle: A selection of recent celebrations that show the atmosphere, rhythm and sensibility we look for in every wedding.

manifesto.quote: What you live in a single day can stay in your memory forever.

contact.title: Book a private video call
contact.description: Tell us how you picture your big day and we'll prepare a first proposal with ideas, moods and the recommended next step.

whatsapp.title: Chat on WhatsApp?
whatsapp.body: Message us with questions, to book a call or to find out more about our services.
whatsapp.message:
Hi! We're starting to plan our wedding and would love to hear more about your wedding planning services.

We love your style and would like to know your availability, the types of service you offer and how you work. We can also share details such as our approximate date, destination and number of guests.

Thank you!
